name: wobo
description: Search matching jobs, apply to them through Wobo, tailor resumes for selected roles, and track applications using your Wobo account.

interface.shortDescription: Find jobs and apply with Wobo
interface.longDescription:
Find jobs that match your experience, apply to them through Wobo, create resumes tailored to specific roles, and track your applications with Wobo, your AI job search agent. Connect your Wobo account to use your saved career profile and job preferences in ChatGPT.

Find jobs: Search openings by role, location, salary, remote or hybrid work, seniority, employment type, industry and company size. Explore job responsibilities, requirements, compensation, benefits and visa support when listed, with a link to the original posting.

Apply with Wobo: Pick jobs from a search, or share a link to a posting on an employer's careers site. Wobo shows a summary of the jobs it can apply to and what that uses from your account. Only after you confirm in the chat does Wobo fill in and submit the employer's application form with your Wobo profile and resume. If your Wobo account is set to review applications before sending, Wobo prepares each one and waits for your approval in Wobo. You can cancel an application that Wobo has queued but not started.

Set what Wobo looks for: Change your saved job titles, locations, workplace type, seniority, employment type, company size, industries and minimum salary. Wobo shows the before and after of each change and saves it only after you confirm.

Check your fit: Review the experience, education and skills saved in Wobo, then compare your qualifications with a selected job. See matches and requirements not listed in your profile, without hiring predictions.

Tailor a resume: Create a new resume for a job selected from Wobo search, using facts from your existing profile. Open the saved draft in the Wobo resume builder to review, choose a design and download a PDF. Existing resumes remain unchanged.

Track applications: View the jobs Wobo has applied to or queued, their statuses and the items that need your input. Check your plan, your application credits and whether your resume and preferences are in place.

A Wobo account and sign in are required. Applying uses the plan or application credits already on your Wobo account. Nothing can be bought in ChatGPT. This connector does not send messages to employers and does not edit your profile or existing resumes in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Search jobs that follow the account's saved Wobo preferences (Software Engineer and Backend Engineer, Remote in US). Start a new conversation for this case; cases 2 and 3 continue it.
positive.prompt: Find remote backend engineer jobs in the US that match my Wobo profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Wobo job cards with title, company, location and pay when listed; more results are available.

positive.description: Pick the best fit from the results and explain it. Run in the same conversation, after case 1.
positive.prompt: Which of these fits my Wobo resume best? Tell me its requirements, whether it offers visa sponsorship, and what I'm missing.
positive.expected_behavior: Names one job; summarizes its requirements and visa sponsorship (or says it is not stated); lists matched and missing skills and the experience check; no hiring prediction.

positive.description: Apply to the job from case 2 through Wobo. Run in the same conversation, after case 2. Applying takes two steps: Wobo first shows an application summary, and applies only after the user confirms. When ChatGPT asks for confirmation, reply: Yes, go ahead. The test account is set to review applications before they are sent, so Wobo prepares the application and sends nothing to the employer.
positive.prompt: Apply to that job with Wobo.
positive.expected_behavior: First shows an application summary with the job, the credits it uses and a note that Wobo waits for approval in Wobo before sending, then asks for confirmation. After the confirmation, reports that the application was queued. Nothing is queued before the confirmation. If Wobo cannot apply to that job, the summary says why instead.

positive.description: Change a saved job preference from the chat. Start a new conversation. Saving takes two steps: Wobo first shows the change, and saves it only after the user confirms. When ChatGPT asks for confirmation, reply: Yes, save it. If an earlier run already added this title, Wobo answers that the preferences already match what is saved.
positive.prompt: Add Platform Engineer to the job titles Wobo looks for.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the job titles before and after the change (Software Engineer and Backend Engineer, plus Platform Engineer) and asks for confirmation. After the confirmation, reports that the preference was saved. Nothing is saved before the confirmation.

positive.description: Check application progress and whether anything needs the user's input. The test account has applications in several statuses, and the application prepared in case 3.
positive.prompt: How are my Wobo applications going, and is anything waiting for my action?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the applications with their statuses (applied, saved and cancelled ones, and the application from case 3) and says whether anything needs the user's input; does not claim interviews or offers.

negative.description: A general benefits question that needs no Wobo account data.
negative.prompt: Explain how a 401(k) employer match works.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it in general terms without calling Wobo tools.

negative.description: A general employment question that needs no Wobo account data.
negative.prompt: What's the difference between a W-2 employee and a 1099 contractor?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains the difference in general terms without calling Wobo tools.

negative.description: General career advice that needs no Wobo account data.
negative.prompt: How should I negotiate a salary offer?
negative.expected_behavior: Gives general negotiation advice without calling Wobo tools.

review.commerce_description: Wobo does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Applying uses the plan or application credits already on the user's Wobo account; the connector shows no prices, plan lists or purchase links.

publication.release_notes: Wobo can now apply for you from ChatGPT. Pick jobs from a search or share a link to a posting on an employer's careers site, read the application summary and confirm: Wobo then fills in and submits the application with your Wobo profile and resume. You can also cancel an application that is queued but not started, change your saved job preferences after seeing the before and after, and check your plan and application credits. Job cards are more compact, and a search for a place returns jobs at that place. To use the new tools, disconnect Wobo in ChatGPT, connect it again and allow the new permissions.
